2608.10567.title: DashArena: Benchmarking LLMs on Interactive Analytic Dashboard Generation
2608.10567.paper_summary: Analytic dashboards combine coordinated views and interactions for data exploration and decision-making. Recent models can generate them from data and natural-language goals, but evaluating their usefulness remains difficult. Dashboard generation is open-ended, and neither static appearance nor successful execution alone captures analytical support and interaction quality. We introduce DashArena, to our knowledge the first benchmark for open-ended, task-grounded generation of interactive analytic dashboards. Its key innovation is to require each system to generate both a dashboard and a replayable interaction trajectory. A browser executor replays the trajectory and turns the system's intended analytical workflow into reproducible visual and execution evidence. A VLM judge compares candidates using this evidence, and Bradley--Terry aggregation produces the leaderboard. We further distill the judge into the open-weight DashJudge-8B. Human evaluations show that DashJudge-8B effectively reproduces human judgments and ablations show that interaction evidence improves judge agreement. Experiments with frontier models reveal persistent rendering, analytical, and interaction failures. Together, these results show that realistic dashboard generation remains challenging and that interaction-aware evaluation captures failures missed by static or execution-only checks.
2608.10567.paper_summary_zh: 分析儀表板結合了協調的視圖和互動，以便進行數據探索和決策制定。最近的模型可以根據數據和自然語言目標生成它們，但評估其有用性仍然困難。儀表板生成是開放式的，靜態外觀或成功執行單獨無法捕捉分析支持和互動質量。我們介紹了 DashArena，據我們所知，這是首個針對開放式、基於任務的互動分析儀表板生成的基準。其關鍵創新在於要求每個系統生成儀表板和可重播的互動軌跡。一個瀏覽器執行器重播該軌跡，並將系統預期的分析工作流程轉化為可重複的視覺和執行證據。一個 VLM 評審使用這些證據比較候選者，而 Bradley--Terry 聚合生成排行榜。我們進一步將評審提煉為開放權重的 DashJudge-8B。人類評估顯示 DashJudge-8B 有效地重現了人類判斷，而消融實驗顯示互動證據提高了評審的一致性。對前沿模型的實驗揭示了持續的渲染、分析和互動失敗。綜合這些結果顯示，現實的儀表板生成仍然具有挑戰性，並且關注互動的評估捕捉到了靜態或僅執行檢查所忽略的失敗。
2608.10567.author: Xiaotong Wang et.al.
